audit_items.proof_trace: EL-imported columns are auto-promoted to VerifiedRODataColumn with explicit trust assumption (line 706: 'We trust the execution layer'), bypassing all 15 validation checks in validateDataColumn() that gossip columns must pass (KZG proofs, proposer signatures, inclusion proofs, subnet validation, slot checks, parent validation, etc.). Both paths converge at receiveDataColumnSidecar() but with fundamentally different verification states.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Compromised execution layer injects malformed columns (invalid KZG proofs, wrong proposer signature, invalid inclusion proof, wrong subnet, future slot) that bypass validateDataColumn() entirely via the trusted EL import path at engine_client.go:706-714, allowing invalid columns to enter the system as if they were gossip-verified.
